summary: Validator targets plan_id toolchain-workflow-repair; requires plan under execution-plans with fixed artifact set including plan-state; validates self-hosted contract, slices W0-W6, TDD intent, command registry, authority partitions, lifecycle state, resume non-authorization, accepted architecture, fixed baseline/candidate commits, exact delta paths and hash bindings, knowledge readiness/freeze, and accepted skill-input/knowledge modules; requires canonical skill-input receipt within plan and ready consumption; supports initial-plan-ready and authorized-repair-revalidate modes; outputs pass/fail receipt with authorizes=[] and no lifecycle transition; optional output writes validator input manifest; ambiguity: required-files set omits plan-state although it is later read, so missing plan-state becomes invalid-plan-artifact.
